falsifier_notes: Overall verdict: PUBLISH WITH CHANGES (applied). Falsifier independently re-fetched the MPA press release and confirmed it is genuine, dated 2026-08-17, and correctly described as an MOU. Confirmed 'MPA's first such agreement with an AI company' would be a safe, narrow claim (no prior MPA-trade-group-level deal with any AI company found; Disney's Dec 2025 OpenAI/Sora deal was studio-level, not MPA-level) -- ultimately NOT used in the published article to avoid an uncited superlative, since no single source directly states this and the verify/falsify research was synthesized across many searches rather than one citable article. Flagged and the article DROPPED two things as a result of falsification: (1) a claim that Seedance 2.5/Seedream 5.0 Pro include face-blocking filters -- only confirmed for the older Seedance 2.0, not the current models, so excluded entirely; (2) a claim attributing C2PA/invisible-watermarking technical details to the MOU itself -- these trace to a separate ByteDance CapCut-newsroom product announcement from 31 July 2026, not to today's MOU, and were dropped from the article rather than risk conflating vendor product claims with MOU terms, given the exact URL could not be pinned down within the cycle's time budget. Also flagged and avoided: a Sen. Markey press release that superficially looked like criticism of this deal but was confirmed to be about an unrelated January 2026 TikTok ownership/divestiture matter -- not cited. No genuine on-the-record criticism or dispute of the 17 August MOU itself was found. Both HR and Deadline were confirmed real but gated behind a TollBit bot-paywall on direct fetch; not used as cited sources for that reason (Variety was fetched directly and used instead). One benign fetch artifact (an odd character-count annotation appended to quotes on first fetch) was investigated and ruled not a prompt injection on a second, targeted re-fetch.
